question_evidence_quote: There are 5 rows of 30 stamps in each of the first 10 pages of her album.
observed_error: The first-group calculation uses 50 pages instead of 10 and incorrectly evaluates the written product as 750 stamps.
violated_condition: The 5-by-30 stamp arrangement applies only to the first 10 pages; the written product 50 × 5 × 30 equals 7500, not 750.
error_description: The response uses all 50 album pages when calculating stamps in the first 10 pages, although only those 10 pages have 5 rows of 30 stamps. Independently, it evaluates the written product 50 × 5 × 30 as 750 stamps rather than 7500 stamps.
secondary_errors: The written multiplication 50 × 5 × 30 is incorrectly evaluated as 750 instead of 7500.
